auditor.role: independent model/source audit, not original author

headline: Approximately $3.1 million per ten California QALYs is defensible as the stated partial-health conditional scenario, not an empirically identified HRS effect or donor endorsement. Missing empirical identification alone is not a reason to revert to null.

arithmetic.method: Independent100000-step midpoint integration of stated survival functions, not reuse of author's closed form.
arithmetic.verdict: All three positive scenarios and expense mean reproduce. Zero if m or e is zero.

modelFindings.evidence: For t<=tau intervention hazard is lambda*(1-e)+mu; afterward both arms again have lambda+mu. The survival advantage after tau decays, rather than disappearing instantly or resetting after every rescue. Integrating survival differences counts each cohort member once; no repeated full-lifetime credit.

Ontario5.3% annual all-cause mortality is not identical to a0.05/year hazard (which implies4.88% mortality), but report calls it calibration and a simplifying prior, not an exact conversion. No forced numerical correction. California1863/100000 is all unintentional overdose after opioid presentation, not a pure opioid death endpoint; existing input wording accurately says unintentional overdose.

d discounts current unique reach; m discounts financing/capacity additionality; x selects relevant recipients; e changes their fatal hazard versus other responses. These can represent separate mechanisms. However x must mean eligibility/usable access, not already-realized mortality reduction; community trial risk ratios cannot be treated as individual treated effect estimates. Proposal explicitly calls e a subjective transfer, so keep numeric value but clarify definitions.

Uses recipient PartIX total including support, not SSP expense slice. No extra program fraction or subtraction of donated contributions. This is a full-accounting recipient-cost donor normalization, not literal marginal cash requirement or societal resource estimate. Unknown public/partner incremental resources correctly retained as limitation.

Other naloxone, EMS and existing service funding continue without gift. Zero branch retained; stress scenarios not confidence bounds. No HIV/HCV/clinic added credit, and omitted harms prevent calling positive result a lower bound. Constant long-run risk and selected post-overdose calibration are substantial, disclosed judgments.

State e is conditional on this group and excludes reach/funding factors already represented by d,m,x.
Round human-facing central price to about$3.1m and stress outputs to about$75000/$38bn; retain precise floats only for reproducibility. Do not imply cent-level estimate accuracy.
May add delayed/partial implementation caveat; null community result is not evidence that delivered naloxone is ineffective.
